hydra_config_path:
seed: 48
n_seeds: 5
experiment_name: s0_mmd_rbf_lgbm
paths:
  data_root: ${oc.env:CHERENKOV_DATA_ROOT,data}
  results_root: ${oc.env:CHERENKOV_RESULTS_ROOT,results}
mlflow:
  tracking_uri: file:./mlruns
  experiment_name: cherenkov-sim2real
scenario:
  name: S0
  data_dir: data/raw/cta_prod5/dl1
  perturbation_intensity: 1.0
  split_ratios:
  - 0.7
  - 0.15
  - 0.15
  subsample: null
method:
  name: mmd_rbf
  lambda_reg: 0.001
  max_iter: 100
classifier: lightgbm
classifier_params:
  n_estimators: 300
  max_depth: 6
  learning_rate: 0.05
model:
  name: logistic_regression
output_dir: results/s0_mmd_rbf_lgbm
